2.3.6.1-f20.left_anchor: and seek about for preferment, tire myself, and trouble all my friends,
2.3.6.1-f20.right_anchor: . And so I say still; although I may not deny, but
2.3.6.1-f20.text: but all my labour was unprofitable; for while death took off some of my friends, to others I remain unknown, or little liked, and these deceive me with false promises. Whilst I am canvassing one party, captivating another, making myself known to a third, my age increases, years glide away, I am put off, and now, tired of the world, and surfeited with human worthlessness, I rest content.

2.3.6.1-f35.left_anchor: be contented, Philip. 4. 11. Come what can come, I am prepared,

2.3.6.1-f35.text: Be it in a great ship or a tiny boat, nevertheless I sail on.
